snippet.title: Five Nights at Frickbear's: Four Layers Down Trailer
snippet.description:
May the Angel have mercy on your soul.

The long-awaited major content expansion for Five Nights at Frickbear's 3, Five Nights at Frickbear's: Four Layers Down (formerly known as the 2.0 update) releases October 23rd, 2026!

Play Frickbear's 3 here: https://gamejolt.com/games/frickbears3/930477
